title: Free radicals: a simpler picture
lead: Round 2. No labels, and nothing wrapped around the glass. The lantern stays; only the Free radicals painting changes. Mockups on the live homepage, computer and phone; nothing is built yet.
why: Only parts everyone knows: a flame, sparks, and the lantern's own glass.
The story in one look: the flame throws sparks, the glass holds most of them in, and the few that get out do harm.

ideas.name: The scorched poppy
ideas.say: Most sparks stay inside the glass. Three get out and scorch the poppy on the right. The poppy on the left is still fresh.
ideas.line: “Most sparks stay behind the glass. The few that get out do harm.”
notes: My score: 9 out of 10. The harm lands on something living, which is the point: your cells.
It pairs with the first painting, where both poppies are fresh.
Small flaw: the burn holes in the petals are tiny. A second take could make them plainer.

ideas.name: Burns on the wood
ideas.say: The same idea. The sparks that get out land on the wooden plank and leave two black burns.
ideas.line: “Most sparks stay behind the glass. The few that get out leave burns.”
notes: My score: 8.5 out of 10. Very clear, but a burnt plank matters less to you than a burnt flower.
